## Open research code

I am progressively making the numerical implementations and reproducibility
material associated with my research publicly available.

This page will be expanded over time as I revisit published work, organize
simulation codes, document numerical experiments, and release them as
reproducible repositories.

::: {.callout-note}
### Work in progress

This is an ongoing project. Repositories are being added gradually, with an
emphasis on clear documentation, reproducibility, and links between the code
and the corresponding publications.
:::

## Available repositories

### Detector-based $H_\infty$ filtering for Markov jump linear systems

[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.22938714.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22938714)

Python implementation and numerical reproduction of the paper

**C. C. Graciani Rodrigues, M. G. Todorov, and M. D. Fragoso**  
*Detector-based approach for $H_\infty$ filtering of Markov jump linear systems with partial mode information*  
*IET Control Theory & Applications*.

The repository includes LMI-based filter synthesis, Algorithm 1, continuous-time
Markov-chain simulations, Monte Carlo experiments, and numerical reproductions
of the examples and figures presented in the paper.

[GitHub repository](https://github.com/caiocesargr/detector-based-hinf-filtering-mjls)
· [Original paper](https://doi.org/10.1049/iet-cta.2018.5640)
· [Software DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22938714)
